CustomField.description: Marks the template used when a message does not select one. An Agent can have only one active default. An Agent with exactly one active template uses it without this being set.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Tick this on the template that should answer when the user has not chosen one (no slash command and the model has not picked another). Only one active template per Agent can be the default.
CustomField.label: Is Default
